data.name: Conflict Actions
table: You perform a melee or ranged attack.
You switch any number of equipped items with any number of items in your backpack. This action doesn't apply to armor.

Only once per turn. Until the start of your next turn:
• You gain resistance to all damage types.
• You gain a +2 bonus to Opposed Checks.
• You may cover another creature and prevent foes from performing melee attacks against them.
You perform DL 10 Check against an opponent. If you succeed, you inflict dazed, shaken, slow, or weak upon them.
You spend Inventory Points to produce and use a consumable item.
You work towards accomplishing an objective within the conflict. This will require a check, and complex goals will require a Clock.
You cast one of the spells you have learned.
You attempt to gain information about someone or something.
You perform a skill that requires you to use an action.
You perform an action that is not covered by any of the above.

data.name: Consumable Items
table: One creature recovers from a single status effect.
One creature Suffers 10 damage of a type of your choice (air, bolt, earth, fire, or ice).
Allows the entire group to rest in the wilderness.

Willpower die reduced by one size.
Dexterity die reduced by one size.
Might die reduced by one size.
